eyebrow: What a second instance really costs
code:
One production instance:            Two production instances:
- one upgrade cycle                  - two upgrades, two regression risks
- one security/ACL model             - two models to keep in sync
- one integration endpoint           - partners potentially need two
- one monitoring setup               - two on-call runbooks
caption: Every platform-wide responsibility repeats, every release, for as long as both exist.
